fixed_proc.text:
Steps that work here:
pickup: walks to the object and picks it up; the hand must be empty first. To carry it to a place use pick_and_place.
put_in R: puts the HELD object into or onto the receptacle R (opens R if closed, and may leave its door open). The object field is the receptacle, not the held item; with nothing held it is an error.
pick_and_place X to R: picks X up and puts it into or onto R (it walks, searches and opens R itself, and may leave its door open); the hand is empty afterwards. Closing R is a separate step. If X is already in your hand use put_in R.
open X: opens a fridge, cabinet, drawer or microwave; it stays open until a close X step. pick_and_place and put_in already open a closed target themselves.
close X: closes it. It is its own step: add it when the command says to close something or to leave it closed.
toggle_on X: switches on a faucet, stove knob, coffee machine, toaster, microwave or light. A burner is switched through its StoveKnob. A Microwave only switches on while its door is closed.
toggle_off X: switches it off again (faucet, stove knob, coffee machine, toaster, microwave, light).
slice X: slices it. The executor needs the ButterKnife in hand; pickup ButterKnife first.
break X: breaks or cracks it (for example an Egg, Mug or Plate).
dirty X: makes it dirty.
clean X: cleans it where it is. To rinse something in the sink use wash instead.
fill X arg: fills the container with a liquid; arg is water, coffee or wine (water when omitted).
empty X: pours the liquid out of the container.
heat X: runs the whole microwave cycle itself (in, door closed, on, out again). Use it only when the command is to warm or heat the food. It is not 'put X in the microwave': X does not stay inside.
cook X: the same whole microwave cycle as heat (put in, close, switch on, take out). Use it only when the command is to cook the food; it does not leave X in the microwave.
wash X: rinses the item in the sink (SinkBasin and Faucet) and leaves it there; the hand is empty afterwards.
go_to X: walks to the object and looks at it.
search_for X: looks for the object in likely places and opens closed containers; it succeeds only if the object is actually seen.
drop: lets go of what you are holding (needs a held object).
close_all: closes every container you have seen open.
crouch: crouches to see low places; stand undoes it.
stand: stands up again after crouch.
To slice: pickup ButterKnife, then slice the food.
To warm food and then place it: heat the food (it does the whole microwave cycle), then pick_and_place it to the place.
To put something in the Microwave: pick_and_place it to Microwave, then close Microwave. This is not heat: heat takes the food out again.
To run the Microwave with something inside: pick_and_place it to Microwave, close Microwave, then toggle_on Microwave (close first). The food stays inside; do not take it out unless the command says to (then: toggle_off Microwave, open Microwave, pickup it). Done when it is inside, the door is closed and it is on.
To run the water: toggle_on Faucet; toggle_off Faucet stops it. wash already switches the Faucet on and off itself, so do not add it to a wash.
To chill food: pick_and_place it to Fridge, then close Fridge.
To put something away in a Cabinet or Drawer: pick_and_place it there, then close it.
To throw something away: pick_and_place it to GarbageCan.
To put dishes in the sink: pick_and_place each one to SinkBasin.
To pour out a container and put it in the sink: empty it, then pick_and_place it to SinkBasin.
To wash a dish: wash it (SinkBasin and Faucet needed); it stays in the sink and the hand ends empty.
To fill a container: fill it with arg water, coffee or wine.
To make coffee: pick_and_place a Mug to CoffeeMachine, then toggle_on CoffeeMachine. Needs a CoffeeMachine; availability unknown, check what you see.
To toast bread: pick_and_place Bread to Toaster, then toggle_on Toaster. Needs a Toaster; availability unknown, check what you see.
To warm a Pot or Pan on the stove: pick_and_place it to StoveBurner, then toggle_on StoveKnob. Needs a StoveBurner and a StoveKnob; availability unknown, check what you see.
To find and take something: search_for it, then pickup (the hand must be empty).
To close everything left open: close_all, or close each container by name.
To boil or fry use a Pot or Pan on the StoveBurner, then toggle_on StoveKnob.
To make coffee put a Mug in the CoffeeMachine, then toggle_on CoffeeMachine.
To chill or keep food cold put it in the Fridge, then close Fridge.
To cut or slice something use the ButterKnife: pickup ButterKnife first.
To throw something away put it in the GarbageCan.
To flip or turn food over use the Spatula: pickup Spatula first.
To warm food use heat (the Microwave); a Pot or Pan is warmed on the StoveBurner with its StoveKnob.
To scoop or stir liquid or soup use the Spoon: pickup Spoon first.
To spread something use the ButterKnife: pickup ButterKnife first.
To pick food up on a prong use the Fork (pickup Fork first); the Spoon is for liquid, the Spatula for flipping.
To toast bread put it in the Toaster, then toggle_on Toaster.
To wash a dish use wash (SinkBasin and Faucet); it switches the water itself.
